result: Using the Claude Code installation CLI in the VPS SSH-VPS, can you copy everything to the other VPS netcap? The idea is that we really want to have everything the same in order to benefit from the same authentication. So I think the best is that you simply zip all the relevant files and then SCP them to the netcap. and then unzip them.
